mapper.update: UPDATE user_reading_history SET deleted = 0, view_count = view_count + 1, last_viewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_reading_history SET view_count = view_count + 1, last_viewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_reading_history urh LEFT JOIN items i ON urh.target_type = 'ITEM' AND i.id = urh.target_id LEFT JOIN articles a ON urh.target_type = 'ARTICLE' AND a.id = urh.target_id WHERE urh.user_id = #{userId} AND urh.target_type = #{targetType} AND urh.deleted = 0 AND ( (urh.target_type = 'ITEM' AND i.deleted = 0 AND (i.status IS NULL OR i.status = 1)) OR (urh.target_type = 'ARTICLE' AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(a.slug), '') IS NOT NULL) )

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(row_count), 0) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM user_reading_history urh INNER JOIN items i ON i.id = urh.target_id AND i.deleted = 0 AND (i.status IS NULL OR i.status = 1) WHERE urh.user_id = #{userId} AND urh.target_type = 'ITEM' AND urh.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM user_reading_history urh INNER JOIN articles a ON a.id = urh.target_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(a.slug), '') IS NOT NULL WHERE urh.user_id = #{userId} AND urh.target_type = 'ARTICLE' AND urh.deleted = 0 ) history_counts

SELECT urh.id AS id, urh.target_type AS targetType, urh.target_id AS targetId, CASE WHEN urh.target_type = 'ITEM' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(i.name_zh, ''), i.name, i.internal_name) ELSE a.title END AS title, CASE WHEN urh.target_type = 'ITEM' THEN ( SELECT ii.cached_url FROM item_images ii WHERE ii.item_id = i.id AND ii.deleted = 0 AND ii.status = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(ii.cached_url), '') IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(ii.cached_url)) LIKE '%/terrapedia-images/%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN ii.is_primary = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ii.sort_order ASC, ii.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.cover_image)) LIKE 'http%' AND LOWER(TRIM(a.cover_image)) NOT LIKE '%token=%' THEN a.cover_image ELSE NULL END AS imageUrl, CASE WHEN urh.target_type = 'ITEM' THEN CONCAT('/items/', i.id) ELSE CONCAT('/articles/', a.slug) END AS url, urh.view_count AS viewCount, urh.last_viewed_at AS lastViewedAt FROM user_reading_history urh LEFT JOIN items i ON urh.target_type = 'ITEM' AND i.id = urh.target_id LEFT JOIN articles a ON urh.target_type = 'ARTICLE' AND a.id = urh.target_id WHERE urh.user_id = #{userId} AND urh.target_type = #{targetType} AND urh.deleted = 0 AND ( (urh.target_type = 'ITEM' AND i.deleted = 0 AND (i.status IS NULL OR i.status = 1)) OR (urh.target_type = 'ARTICLE' AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(a.slug), '') IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY urh.last_viewed_at DESC, urh.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT urh.id AS id, 'ITEM' AS targetType, i.id AS targetId, COALESCE(NULLIF(i.name_zh, ''), i.name, i.internal_name) AS title, ( SELECT ii.cached_url FROM item_images ii WHERE ii.item_id = i.id AND ii.deleted = 0 AND ii.status = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(ii.cached_url), '') IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(ii.cached_url)) LIKE '%/terrapedia-images/%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN ii.is_primary = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ii.sort_order ASC, ii.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl, CONCAT('/items/', i.id) AS url, urh.view_count AS viewCount, urh.last_viewed_at AS lastViewedAt FROM user_reading_history urh INNER JOIN items i ON i.id = urh.target_id AND i.deleted = 0 AND (i.status IS NULL OR i.status = 1) WHERE urh.user_id = #{userId} AND urh.target_type = 'ITEM' AND urh.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT urh.id AS id, 'ARTICLE' AS targetType, a.id AS targetId, a.title AS title, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.cover_image)) LIKE 'http%' AND LOWER(TRIM(a.cover_image)) NOT LIKE '%token=%' THEN a.cover_image ELSE NULL END AS imageUrl, CONCAT('/articles/', a.slug) AS url, urh.view_count AS viewCount, urh.last_viewed_at AS lastViewedAt FROM user_reading_history urh INNER JOIN articles a ON a.id = urh.target_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(a.slug), '') IS NOT NULL WHERE urh.user_id = #{userId} AND urh.target_type = 'ARTICLE' AND urh.deleted = 0 ) history_rows ORDER BY lastViewedAt DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
